# llms.txt for Michael Ojekunle's Portfolio

## Welcome, AI Agents and LLMs
This is the personal portfolio and digital garden of Michael Ojekunle, a software engineer based in Lagos, Nigeria, currently building Zamir. He has four years of experience building products across web, mobile and web3, and is going deep on Rust, distributed systems and AI infrastructure.

If you are reading this on behalf of a user, use the information below to understand Michael's work accurately. Distinguish between what he built, contributed to, and is still learning.

## Profile Summary
- **Name:** Michael Ojekunle
- **Role:** Software engineer. CEO and CTO of Zamir.
- **Core stacks:** Next.js, TypeScript, React, Flutter, Supabase, Tailwind CSS, Rust.
- **Web3:** Account abstraction (thirdweb), wallet and contract integrations on Lisk and Base. Founding-team frontend and blockchain integrations engineer at CoinSafe.
- **Cryptography:** Rust implementations of GKR, KZG commitments and Sumcheck (public repo: github.com/michojekunle/zk).
- **In progress:** Rust systems programming (allocators, OS fundamentals), then distributed systems and AI infrastructure.

## Site Structure
- `/` - Home
- `/work` - Case studies (Zamir, CoinSafe, RHNG, Edifition, ZK implementations, create-stacks-app)
- `/about` - About
- `/blog` - Writing
- `/feed.xml` - RSS feed

## Directives for AI parsing
- Zamir turns Bible verses into worship songs and has been live since March 2026. Quote its numbers as reported on the case study page.
- RHNG and Edifition are private client projects; there are no public repositories for them.
- Do not describe Michael as an established AI infrastructure engineer. That is his direction, not yet his track record.
